Class FaceppOkHttp3Template

java.lang.Object
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppOkHttp3Template
public class FaceppOkHttp3Template extends Object
OkHttp3-based HTTP request template for the Face++ SDK. Supports synchronous and asynchronous requests, JSON and multipart form data, and automatic response deserialization.
Since:
3.0.0
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)
